verdict.rationale: Devin has its own mechanisms for loading reusable instructions: Knowledge, which it references in every session, and AGENTS.md support. Playbooks are named only in passing in the MCP docs. None of this is documented as a dedicated skills system for packaging specialized capabilities. The Devin Handoff 'skill' is for other agents, not for extending Devin, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: a documented custom-skill/playbook authoring workflow, detail on how playbooks package specialized tasks (tools, scripts, triggers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Knowledge is a collection of instructions and advice that Devin can reference in all sessions.
Devin supports AGENTS.md - a simple, open standard for providing context and instructions to AI agents.
it gives any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling
